pages.text: $(bold)Tier 1 Materials$(/bold)$(br2)Iron · Copper · Brass (Create) · Tin · Bronze$(br2)$(bold)What's absent:$(/bold) Diamonds have been removed from Overworld worldgen and all Overworld structure chests. Steel requires Thermal Series (Tier 2). Netherite requires the Nether (Tier 3).$(br2)Your Tier 1 ceiling is a finely crafted bronze or brass weapon/armor set with Common Apotheosis affixes.

$(bold)Cross-Tier Material Peek$(/bold)$(br2)You can get $(italic)a taste$(/italic) of next-tier materials before unlocking the tier — never enough to build a factory, always enough to feel the reward.$(br2)$(bold)Transmutation:$(/bold) KubeJS recipes let you convert 32–64 current-tier ingots into 1 next-tier ingot. Inefficient by design.$(br2)$(bold)Boss drops:$(/bold) Current-tier bosses have a 5–15% chance to drop 1–3 next-tier materials.

$(bold)Tier 2 Materials$(/bold)$(br2)Steel (Thermal) · Manasteel (Botania) · Signalum · Lumium · Steeleaf · Ironwood · Fiery (Twilight Forest)$(br2)$(bold)Diamond access:$(/bold) Limited diamond access via expensive transformation recipes only. Twilight Forest bosses occasionally drop small amounts.$(br2)$(bold)Apotheosis:$(/bold) Uncommon + Rare affixes, 2 sockets, Chipped/Normal gems.

$(bold)Tier 3 Materials$(/bold)$(br2)Diamond (full access) · Terrasteel · Elementium · Enderium · Osmium · Refined Obsidian$(br2)$(bold)Tier 4 Materials$(/bold)$(br2)Netherite · Gaia Ingots · Dragon Scales/Hearts · Antimatter · Atomic Alloy$(br2)$(bold)Boss materials$(/bold) are a separate category — unique crafting components dropped only by specific bosses, used in high-end recipes and waystone construction.
